Priya: Observed repeated OOMs on Tempest18b int4 during warm-multi-turns. p50 steady, p99 spikes when KV warms. Short log below.

Priya: ```
[2026-03-25T11:07:08Z] serve: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
model=tempest18b-v1-int4 shard=4 seq_len=460 batch=1 new_tokens=160
KV_used=84% slab_frag=0.39
```

Omar: ouch. what's the canary config right now? microbatch/prefetch/max_new_tokens/slot_reserve?

Priya: current canary:```
model: tempest18b-v1-int4
replicas: 4
microbatch_size: 2
batch_timeout_ms: 10
prefetch: on
max_new_tokens_default: 220
slot_reserve: 0.08
soft_evict: false
```

Chen: this smells like fragmentation + aggressive prefetch. slab_frag ~0.4 means allocations fail when concurrent KV grows. Quick conservative changes: prefetch=false, microbatch_size=1, max_new_tokens_default=120, slot_reserve=0.20, enable soft_evict and set kv_trim_pct=0.28. Also enable gradual_slowstart for canary to ramp traffic.

Rafael: also consider switching kernel_pref to "memory-lean" on the canary shard. Some kernels prefer lower memory footprints at cost of a few ms. Add microbatch_join_ms=6 to allow short joins and reduce allocation pulses. Proposed patch:```
set rollout.tempest18b.canary {
  overrides: {
    prefetch: false,
    microbatch_size: 1,
    microbatch_join_ms: 6,
    batch_timeout_ms: 8,
    max_new_tokens_default: 120,
    slot_reserve: 0.20,
    soft_evict: true,
    kv_trim_pct: 0.28,
    gradual_slowstart: true,
    kernel_pref: "memory-lean"
  }
}
```

infra-bot: ALERT: node-gpu-15 memory pressure at 2026-03-25T11:06:55Z while running tempest18b-canary-4. free_mem trending down.

Chen: after change we should run a quick int4 vs int8 quant-quality check (semantic sim + rouge) and a 6k A/B with fallback to tempest18b-v1-int8 if semantic sim drops >1.5%. Command we use:```
./eval_harness --model tempest18b-v1-int4 --baseline tempest18b-v1-int8 --evalset conversational-smoke,adversarial-longform --metrics semantic_sim,rouge --run-id tempest-1705202 --save-diffs
```

Priya: I can own the A/B and slab snapshots. I'll add a slab_snap hook to runbook and capture per-shard slab_frag and KV_used every 30s. Also will capture nvprof --memory trace for the failing shard.

Rafael: note that reducing max_new_tokens_default impacts tail-case throughput; we'll monitor p50/p99 carefully. microbatch=1 might nudge p50 up; microbatch_join_ms=6 should mitigate some tailbloat. If p50 rises too much, we can test hybrid: microbatch=1 with adaptive batching for heavy traffic shards.

QA-Bot: queued: will alert if semantic_sim drops >1.5% or p99 latency increases >30% relative to baseline.

Omar: I'll push the rollout now and watch prometheus dash (mem/cuda_free, slab_frag, p99_lat). If OOMs persist after the conservative changes, fallback to: increase slot_reserve to 0.30, enable kv_sparse_trim=0.4, and temporary traffic throttle to 10%.

Priya: thanks. pushing patch in 1m. will post eval link when available. :rocket:
